      "id": "ADMISSION-OWNER-CAPABILITY-1",
      "severity": "must",
      "obligation": "implementation",
      "status": "open",
      "root_cause": "ArbitrationAdmissionService没有绑定自身经合法取得/接管获得的所有者能力。EnsureOwnership只是TryAcquire转发；SubmitAsync、MarkOperationTerminalLocked、SettleReconciledAsync等入口直接读取文件中的当前Lease并使用它的LeaseId/OwnerEpoch。TaskCenterHost的_admission持续缓存，EnsureAdmissionFacadeAsync见非null立即返回；Host捕获的_admissionLeaseId/_admissionOwnerEpoch只用于心跳和释放，终局调用未携带原身份。因此流程起点捕获保护只能挡住捕获之后的更替，不能挡住旧实例在更替之后借读新所有者身份。",
